meta.title: A framework for safe software releases

gif.title: A release framework
gif.subtitle: Build it once, reuse it for every new service

cards.title: Service inventory
cards.body: List every service in one catalog with a named owner.
cards.caption: One catalog, named owners

cards.title: Risk tiers
cards.body: Classify each service by impact. The tier decides how strict the controls must be.
cards.caption: Risk level sets the controls

cards.title: Ownership
cards.body: Assign clear owners across engineering and security so nothing falls through gaps.
cards.caption: Every service has an owner

cards.title: Policies and standards
cards.body: Turn principles into written rules and testable checks.
cards.caption: Principles to checks

cards.title: Approval workflow
cards.body: Route each change through intake, review, and sign-off before production.
cards.caption: No sign-off, no release

cards.title: Controls and testing
cards.body: Validate every build for bugs, performance, and security before release.
cards.caption: Build to tests to release

cards.title: Monitoring
cards.body: Track errors, latency, and usage and alert when a metric crosses its threshold.
cards.caption: Alert at the threshold

cards.title: Audit trails
cards.body: Log who changed what, when, and in which version.
cards.caption: Who did what, and when

cards.title: Compliance mapping
cards.body: Link each control to the standards that apply. One control set serves many frameworks.
cards.caption: One control set, many rules

takeaways.title: One control library
takeaways.body: Build once, reuse for every service.
